# OpenAPI 3.1 meta-schema (vendored test fixture)

`oas-3.1-schema-2022-10-07.json` is the official JSON Schema of OpenAPI 3.1.x documents, fetched
unchanged from <https://spec.openapis.org/oas/3.1/schema/2022-10-07>
(sha256 `da01ba28852cac0de53893797cb8d1942bc3b05084f526dcc216717dec314ed0`).
`tests/openapi.rs` validates generated documents against it, offline.
